test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Bindu, Krunal, Manoj, Nilima, Omkar, Piyush, Renu and Sundar are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order. Sundar sits second to the right of Piyush. Only two persons sit between Sundar and Krunal. Omkar sits opposite to Bindu, who is not an immediate neighbour of Krunal and Piyush. Nilima is the immediate neighbour of Krunal and Bindu. Manoj sits third to the right of Bindu. 

Which of the following statements is/are true?

options.text: Omkar is the immediate neighbour of Renu and Piyush.
Sundar sits third to the right of Krunal.
Nilima sits opposite the one who sits to the immediate left of Renu.
Manoj is the immediate neighbour of Nilima.

solution:
**Eight person: **Bindu, Krunal, Manoj, Nilima, Omkar, Piyush, Renu and Sundar are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Sundar sits second to the right of Piyush.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9b32ff9e5e9002f0f80f2f4eea67a246c5920abbbeff9482950e7aaccacbe73.png] 

2) Only two persons sit between Sundar and Krunal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40d86a25cdf71fe0b11a850b8023c81508875fb9e012d757bdbca4f1147876f6.png] 

3) Omkar sits opposite to Bindu, who is not an immediate neighbour of Krunal and Piyush.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b78a751ddf34aa58882cd97507419aeee8b92d1db956ec18cfde9d38ca23ffa.png] 

4) Manoj sits third to the right of Bindu.

5) Nilima is the immediate neighbour of Krunal and Bindu.

6) Only one position left for Renu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffce36fdb135850fa37bd0460059983fc64a998057b8028e855a15f2364dbc02.png] 

Clearly, Nilima sits opposite the one who sits to the immediate left of Renu. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Nilima sits opposite the one who sits to the immediate left of Renu".**
